publication: Proceedings of the 9th Workshop on Balto-Slavic Natural Language Processing (BSNLP) / WILDRE-6 workshop at LREC 2022
purpose: Academic baseline and linguistic evaluation for Hindi-English code-switching and language identification (HingLID).

provenance_boundary.description: L3Cube-HingCorpus is an academic code-mixed Hindi-English corpus written in Roman script. It contains general web/social conversations, NOT financial or payment recovery communications. Payment domain datasets in Vaada are authored separately in data/domain/payment_hinglish/.
